An Introduction to the new C++ 26 "Reflection" Feature - Inbal Levi - CppCon 2025
---

This talk will introduce what is (likely) the final version of the ""Reflection"" feature targeting C++26. 
 
With a proposal to introduce reflection to C++26 (including the “std::meta” namespace) slated to be voted into the standard in June 2025, we can already start imagining a whole new world of possibilities. 
 
In this session, we will dive into reflection and its transformative potential within our codebases. We will start with a brief history of ""reflection"" history. We'll continue with an introduction of utilities from the latest reflection proposal. Then, we delve deeper into practical applications and demonstrate solutions to problems that commonly use reflection and the power it holds.
